invariants.rationale: The TiledMap reference should not be null for object loading to make sense.
The MapLayer must not be null when accessing its objects or calling methods on it.
JsonValue element should not be null as it is likely used to parse map object data.
Objects collection of the MapLayer should be initialized to store loaded map objects.

invariants.expression: map != null && layer != null && layer.getObjects() != null
invariants.rationale: If map and layer are not null, then the objects list on the layer should also be non-null.
